sections.h2: How to use a H&M promo code
sections.html:
1. Pick an offer above and tap Get code to reveal and copy it (deals and member perks need no code).
  2. Open www2.hm.com, add the items you want to your cart and check they meet the offer's terms.
  3. Paste the code into the promo or discount box at checkout and check the price drops before you pay.

• Spend-and-save offers usually exclude sale items and designer collaborations.
  • H&M membership is free and adds member bonus rewards.

faqs.q: Is there a H&M discount code right now?

faqs.q: How does VoucherVault check H&M codes?
faqs.a: We only list offers we have seen on H&M's own site or app, or in its official affiliate feed, and show the date we last checked each one. Offers with a published end date disappear when it passes; offers without one are hidden if we haven't re-checked them recently.

faqs.q: Why isn't my H&M code working?
faqs.a: The usual reasons are: the code only covers selected items, you haven't reached a minimum spend, it is for new customers or app orders only, it can't be combined with another offer, or it has just ended. Read the terms on the offer and check your basket meets them.
